description: PROPOSED (issue #107 / Discussion #108, not yet normative): Lenient consumption relaxes only the unknown-field check. A document with an unknown ResultSet-level key AND a list-typed `Result.actual_output` is still rejected under `mode: allow_unknown`, and the only reported problem is the TYPE_ERROR at $.results[0].actual_output (the case ChelseaKR found in ChelseaKR/gauntlet#76).
